description: Commit a Context Passport record of an agent decision or action. Returns a verifiable record id and verify_url. Use this when the agent makes a decision worth recording for later audit or verification.

agent_id.description: Optional. Identifier for the calling agent.

event_type.description: Optional. One of: commit, fork, checkpoint, spawn, retry, timeout, error, override, consent, escalate, redact, audit. Defaults to 'commit'.

input.description: What the agent received (string or object).

output.description: What the agent produced (string or object).

provider.description: Optional. LLM provider (anthropic, openai, mistral, etc).

role.description: Optional. Semantic role (researcher, writer, reviewer, etc).

session_id.description: Optional. Groups passports into a chain. Defaults to 'default'.

trace_id.description: Optional. Groups commits into a pipeline run.

variables.description: Optional. Named values for downstream agents.

name: darkmatter_commit
